หัวข้อ: Supermarkets urged to limit food prices by government
เนื้อหา: Any price caps would be voluntary apply to key groceries such as eggs, bread, and milk, the BBC understands.

เนื้อหา: The new cost range and train speed are being announced as a "reset" of the delayed, over-budget and vastly scaled-back project is carried out.

[BBC Business]
หัวข้อ: Faisal Islam: Why a full HS2 line could still be built despite the latest fiasco
เนื้อหา: The Transport Secretary has said the high-speed rail line will not be completed until 2039.

[CNBC]
หัวข้อ: Trump's past tax returns get protection from IRS enforcement under 'lawfare' fund settlement
เนื้อหา: President Trump agreed to drop his lawsuit against the IRS in exchange for a fund that can compensate allies who were targeted under the Biden administration.

[CNBC]
หัวข้อ: Google debuts new AI models, personal AI agents in effort to keep pace with OpenAI and Anthropic
เนื้อหา: Google made a number of AI announcements at its annual developer conference, rolling out more-advanced models and agentic tools for its expansive user base.

[CNBC]
หัวข้อ: Vance defends stock-trading spree in Trump financial filings: 'Come on, man'
เนื้อหา: Vice President JD Vance said at the White House on Tuesday that he and President Donald Trump both support banning congressional stock trading.

[CNBC]
หัวข้อ: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.19%, highest since before the financial crisis
เนื้อหา: Global bond markets remained on edge as traders monitored central bank responses to renewed inflation fears.

[CNBC]
หัวข้อ: Mortgage rates surge to highest level since July
เนื้อหา: Mortgage rates continued to move higher Tuesday on uncertainty over the war with Iran. They are at the highest level since last July.

หัวข้อ: These charts offer a warning to the next generation — a new era of higher Treasury yields may be coming
เนื้อหา: This “pennant” chart pattern warns that Treasury yields could be headed much higher. But an alternative scenario isn’t so good either.

[MarketWatch]
หัวข้อ: Here’s why Astera Labs’ stock just staged a big gain
เนื้อหา: Investors seemed pleased by the connectivity company’s firm timeline for a new switch and its talk of revenue opportunities in optical networking.

[MarketWatch]
หัวข้อ: CoreWeave’s stock falls as new Google cloud venture may signal more competition ahead
เนื้อหา: A joint venture between Google and Blackstone isn’t “immediately problematic” for CoreWeave, but rather a sign that the market could get more crowded, according to a Bernstein analyst.

[MarketWatch]
หัวข้อ: Home Depot says its sales are healthy, but here’s where customers are holding back
เนื้อหา: Shares of Home Depot crept higher on Tuesday after the home- improvement giant kept its full-year outlook intact — a relief for investors worried that higher gasoline prices due to the Iran war would further crimp consumer spending.

[MarketWatch]
หัวข้อ: Shein’s reported purchase of Everlane shows that price trumps principles for many shoppers today
เนื้อหา: Everlane is reportedly being sold to Shein. Depop was sold at a markdown. Allbirds is now an AI company. Sustainable fashion is getting less sustainable.
